title: Configure Kutt
description: Configure the Kutt URL shortener. Settings left out keep their current value.

host.description: Host name of the short links, like 'kutt.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

site_name.description: Name of the site shown by Kutt (SITE_NAME)

link_length.description: Length of the generated short addresses (LINK_LENGTH)

link_custom_alphabet.description: Characters of the generated short addresses (LINK_CUSTOM_ALPHABET)

disallow_registration.description: Disable the sign-up of new users (DISALLOW_REGISTRATION)

disallow_login_form.description: Hide the e-mail and password login form, leaving OIDC login (DISALLOW_LOGIN_FORM)

disallow_anonymous_links.description: Allow only logged-in users to create links (DISALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LINKS)

server_ip_address.description: IP address shown to users who add a custom domain (SERVER_IP_ADDRESS)

server_cname_address.description: Host name shown to users who add a custom domain, for a CNAME record (SERVER_CNAME_ADDRESS)

custom_domain_use_https.description: Use HTTPS in the short links of custom domains (CUSTOM_DOMAIN_USE_HTTPS)

report_email.description: Address that receives the reports of malicious links (REPORT_EMAIL)

mail_from.description: Sender of the Kutt e-mails, like 'Kutt <noreply@domain.org>' (MAIL_FROM). Empty: the site name at noreply@<host>.

oidc_enabled.description: Log in with an OpenID Connect provider (OIDC_ENABLED)

oidc_issuer.description: Issuer URL of the OpenID Connect provider (OIDC_ISSUER)

oidc_client_secret.description: OpenID Connect client secret (OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET). Empty: keep the current secret.

oidc_email_claim.description: Claim that holds the user e-mail address (OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM)

oidc_prompt.description: OpenID Connect prompt parameter, like 'login' or 'consent' (OIDC_PROMPT)

oidc_button_text.description: Text of the OpenID Connect login button (OIDC_BUTTON_TEXT)
